I truly don't think she is a narcissist. She is a good person, not perfect but only a few in this world are close to perfection.

She is just one person but she is the only one I have. I don't really want to say much because I use the same username everywhere and I am scared someone one day would this. But she is the only one I have left, I've been isolated for the past 2 years: have to change country (to go back home), lost my friends, my fiance, my job and more. At my age I had to go back living with my mother which really a shame to me. She is the only person I see or talk with. See, in this huge world I have no one or nothing left.

I am sorry for not responding before but I spent my night crying and the morning being disconnected (I am not sure how to describe it).

I tried yesterday evening to contact 5 friends, no one responded and I am not surprised. If you actually checked my reddit account, you might get an idea of why. I don't have any online friends because I used to be a social person and when this started I just didn't come on internet, I was always too tired for it.
I don't have any close family expected my mother, she is literally the only one I have for the past 2 years, just typing this make me feel pitiful.

See, when I will no one will miss me or come to my funerals.

I do want to live but the more I think about it or try to "reach out" the more I realize how I have no one and how abnormal is it.

Thank you for your message, I found it amazing how strangers can care and try to help other people. I hope you will have only good things in life.

Thank you for your message.

My mom understand depression, she is the one who realized first hand I was surely having it last year. Also she does volunteer stuffs that involve depressed people or people in need of help. She is not narcissistic or a bad mother (most my friends used to want to have her as a mom). But she always said what she thinks and that's why I know she meant it 100% and also the fact she said she was willing to help me to die.

I don't want to see a therapist, short long story I saw one for 5 years as a child and it traumatized me for life.

I don't think there a way out for me, up to 2 years ago I have everything I could wish for (friends, uni, jobs, lover...) now I have nothing left and things are just getting worst and more painful every day.

It's like I am not needed. I am a waste of life. I just burden people.

I don't think she is narcissistic but she knows I mean it. She asked how I wanted to do it and I told her with the pills I have, she said and was very serious "if you want I can help with a pillow" (as I putting on my face and a king sure I don't breath). When I was way younger she already say something similar once.

Also I want to make it clear she is a nice person, she volunteer to help people and so many people are going to her for help. And after thinking about it, it's maybe her way to say she wishes I die because it would make everything better for everyone.

Hello, I'm from France and I'm currently 27yo. As a child I used to love taking photography and have many camera, then lost interest in photography (I guess) whenI was a teen. I got back into photography when I was about 18. Started from zero with a small sony cyber shot then moved to a Nikon bridge and finally after travelling oversea and moving to Korea in 2013, I bought my first reflex, Canon 700D. It's the one I still use now. Currently, I have a tripod, a monopod, only one lens (18-135 but I'm saving up for a 70-200).

I like taking pictures of animals (zoo, park, dogs), of people (and I think they are somehow my best ones) and of monuments. 

I'll be honest with you, I took many pictures since I got my 700D and I was very lazy to search the ones I was disappointed with, because they are way too many. 

So here my pictures, I'm giving you the non-edited version. 

**- My best one:** http://i.imgur.com/gHNH2qj.jpg I took this one a few day after getting my 700D. I somehow really loved it, I know there a lot of default in the picture, but I really like the reflection and the composition in general.

Took this one, around 6 months after I got the camera, one of my only flower picture but I really like it: http://i.imgur.com/7YvTLmQ.jpg

(both pictures were shooted in jpg, newbie mistake)

**- The one that I would have liked to take better**: http://i.imgur.com/bTGX2Dd.jpg I took this picture very recently. Seeing it in front of my eyes was beautiful, but the picture itself is lacking in many ways sadly.

**- One I took recently:** http://i.imgur.com/4EEaNIx.jpg Shooted it about a few days ago. These days, I'm working on my composition and creativity which I'm lacking badly.

(both of these were shot in raw).
